literal_meaning: ছটফট করা বা মাছের মতো তড়পানো
figurative_meaning_en: To fuss or struggle in vain
similar_in_english: kick and scream to no avail
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পরীক্ষায় ফেল করেছে, এখন তড়পানোর কোনো লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: No matter how much you wriggle, nothing will happen.
He failed the exam; there's no point in struggling futilely now.
note: This idiom evokes the image of a fish struggling out of water, common in Bengali rural expressions.
